title: Teach Us to Number Our Days

request.style: English, traditional hymn, warm male baritone lead with four-part choir, pipe organ, soft strings, stately and reflective, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
Through all generations
Before the mountains were born
From everlasting to everlasting you are God

[Verse]
A thousand years in your sight
Are like a day that has just gone by
Like grass that springs up in the morning
By evening it withers and dries up

[Chorus]
Teach us to number our days
That we may gain a heart of wisdom
Teach us to number our days
That we may gain a heart of wisdom

[Verse]
Seventy years, that is the span of our life
Or eighty, if we have the strength
They pass quickly, and we fly away
Turn back, LORD, have compassion on your servants

[Chorus]
Teach us to number our days
That we may gain a heart of wisdom
Teach us to number our days
That we may gain a heart of wisdom

[Bridge]
Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love
That we may sing for joy and be glad all our days

[Outro]
May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us
Establish the work of our hands
Yes, establish the work of our hands
